name: Pannest Integrated Services
subtitle: Surface & Cold Chain Pharma Logistics
campaign: Pharma Cold Chain B2B Lead Generation
challenge: Generate qualified B2B inquiries from pharmaceutical companies, vaccine manufacturers, and diagnostic labs requiring certified 2-8°C and 15-25°C refrigerated transport, while strictly eliminating retail consumer parcel tracking searches.
approach: Constructed an exact-match Google Search campaign structure segmented by temperature category (Reefer, Cold Chain, Ambient).
Pruned 400+ negative keywords including consumer tracking terms, cheap parcel services, and domestic baggage delivery.
Drafted high-authority responsive search ad copy detailing real-time IoT temperature data loggers and GDP compliance certificates.
Engineered a dedicated B2B logistics quote landing page capturing cargo type, pallet volume, temperature range, and dispatch frequency.
Deployed Target CPA bidding strategy once a stable conversion baseline was established.
result: Captured 29+ enterprise cold chain inquiries with an exceptional 8.50% Search CTR and reduced verified Cost Per Lead to ₹247 across 342 verified leads.

strategies.title: 01 TEMPERATURE INTENT KEYWORD HARVEST
strategies.description: Isolating high-intent commercial pharma queries like 'refrigerated pharma transport 2-8C', 'pharma cold chain logistics pan-India', and 'temperature controlled reefer fleet'.

strategies.title: 02 NEGATIVE KEYWORD FORTIFICATION
strategies.description: Excluded retail consumer tracking keywords, personal courier terms, and retail luggage inquiries, saving over 35% of ad spend.

strategies.title: 03 COMPLIANCE & GDP EXTENSIONS
strategies.description: Configured Google Ad extensions highlighting real-time IoT temperature monitoring, GPS tracking, and validated temperature mapping.

strategies.title: 04 B2B QUOTE FORM RE-ENGINEERING
strategies.description: Redesigned landing page quote forms to qualify pallet dimensions, temperature brackets, and route frequency, tripling commercial conversion.

keyLearnings: Temperature-specific search headlines ('2°C to 8°C Certified Reefer Transport') generated 2.8x higher CTR than generic logistics headlines.
Aggressive negative keyword curation eliminated 38% of wasted ad spend from retail package tracking queries.
Including compliance certificates (GDP, ISO, FSSAI) directly in ad extensions doubled phone inquiry conversion rates.
